statement: Earlier audited HERMES/FIFO full-track comparison has an inconclusive accuracy difference in its tested configuration
needed_evidence: Preserve scope, mixed-session limits and uncertainty when citing
claim_limit: Does not establish universal HERMES failure or equivalence

statement: Fresh causal scorer matches native attention and preserves source cache on the checked GPU preflight prefix
needed_evidence: Additional validity checks if extending the scorer or claiming validity beyond the tested cases
claim_limit: One 16-frame prefix before/after forced pruning; does not independently certify every later chunk

statement: Fresh causal scoring shows no correctness gain over current HERMES in the selected screen
existing_evidence: results/causal_pilot_2026-11-20/pairwise_outcomes.csv: 40 questions, one wrong-to-wrong choice change, zero correctness changes
needed_evidence: Broader justified evidence before any general effectiveness or equivalence claim
claim_limit: Selected pilot cannot estimate population benefit or establish equivalence

statement: The proposed method is distinct from the closest existing mechanisms
needed_evidence: Written algorithm and full-method/code comparison with nearest work
claim_limit: A new name, generic combination or reproduction correction does not establish novelty

statement: The original method improves a useful QA/memory/cost trade-off over matched controls
needed_evidence: Frozen treatment, current/fresh/FIFO and nearest feasible prior control, ablations and appropriate uncertainty
claim_limit: No invented improvement percentage; include regressions and total auxiliary cost

statement: The claimed benefit generalizes beyond development cases
existing_evidence: Existing benchmark outcomes have already informed research direction
needed_evidence: Appropriate independent confirmation and/or compatible additional setting with source-overlap checks
claim_limit: A subset of an inspected benchmark is not an untouched external test

existing_evidence: Prior timing scopes and new shared-feature replay design
needed_evidence: Separate full-system arrival, decode, encoder, maintenance and query measurements if claiming this
claim_limit: Replay timing excludes shared vision preparation and does not establish live latency

statement: Submission package meets journal and graduation requirements
existing_evidence: Supplied Neurocomputing guide; user says Q1 mandatory and original method required
needed_evidence: Final manuscript, correct article type, qualifying ranking category/year, authorship/milestone checks and author approval
claim_limit: Author guide does not verify Q1 or guarantee acceptance

statement: FIFO/HERMES historical choices replay exactly on the 40 selected questions
needed_evidence: Additional checks if claiming wider pipeline/hardware equivalence
claim_limit: No whole-benchmark or cross-hardware equivalence claim

statement: Three shared failures occur before any prior token eviction
needed_evidence: Exact support inspection and capability/input controls to identify root cause
claim_limit: Does not prove a unique perception, sampling or annotation cause

statement: Fresh-state input controls show 14 of 40 question-only and 25 of 40 recent-four versus 21 of 40 recent-twenty
needed_evidence: Support localization and controlled input interventions
claim_limit: Outcome-selected development results do not establish a general window advantage

statement: Native prefix scores 10 of 14 with choices identical to all historical baselines on that subset
needed_evidence: Separate broader feasible evaluation for wider native-baseline claims
claim_limit: Do not compare 10 of 14 directly against 24 of 40

statement: Recent-four recovers 204 q0 while its full eight-frame uncompressed prefix fails
needed_evidence: Support-only and fixed-position content controls plus chunking checks
claim_limit: No eviction in native input; semantic distraction is not uniquely established
